_comment: Prefix map for the DCAT-US 3.0 RDF binding. Every entry records where it came from. The baseline is the only context DCAT-US has ever published (DOI-DO/dcat-us@main:context/dcat-us-3.0.jsonld, HTTP 200, 48311 bytes, retrieved 2026-08-20). Three entries are corrected; each correction carries its evidence and can be reverted with --literal-namespaces.

dc.note: Used by Document.publisher (dc:publisher). Absent from the legacy context, so a document using it could not be expanded at all.

org.note: The W3C Organization Ontology declares its namespace as http://www.w3.org/ns/org# (fetched from https://www.w3.org/ns/org, Turtle: '@prefix org: <http://www.w3.org/ns/org#>'). The legacy context says www.w3c.org, a different host. It redirects in a browser, so the error is invisible to a human, but in RDF the two produce distinct IRIs and org:Organization minted from the legacy value does not join to the canonical class.

xsd.note: Needed for datatype coercion; the legacy context omits it.

dcat-us.note: data.resources.gov does not resolve (DNS failure). resources.data.gov returns HTTP 200 and is the host the JSON Schema $id values use. Commit d5cd9531 in the predecessor repository, 'replace data.resources.gov to resources.data.gov in all files', did not reach the context. Only the host is corrected here; the scheme and path are left as published.
